data.title: 伽玛 · 巧克力新品发布会
data.description: 四越商会新品发布会上，伽玛身着头取套装，亲手揭开盖在巧克力礼盒上的绸布。王都的贵妇与商人们屏息以待——这又是暗影大人随口提过的味道。
data.location: elegant product launch hall with a display table of chocolate gift boxes and gathered noble guests
data.action: unveiling a chocolate gift box with a flourish, graceful presenter smile, business suit
data.lighting: 发布会大厅水晶吊灯的璀璨灯光
data.promptProse: Gamma unveils Mitsugoshi's new chocolate line before the capital's nobility, another of Shadow's casual ideas turned into gold.
data.animaCaption: One cloth lifted, and the capital's purses open — Gamma smiles like she planned it all along. She did.
